newsitem.title: SPAIN: Gas Natural shares soar after results.
newsitem.headline: Gas Natural shares soar after results.

text.p: Shares in Spanish energy group Gas Natural soared on Tuesday after the company posted better than expected nine month results, traders said.
Gas Natural rose 600 pesetas to 23,800 by 1330 GMT. The Ibex-35 index of leading shares was up 0.72 percent to 4,453.41.
"The results were better than expected, especially at the operating level but also at the net level," said one trader.
The company said its net consolidated profit for the first nine months of 1996 rose 33 percent to 33.545 billion pesetas. Operating profit rose 21 percent to 59.5 billion pesetas.
"The feeling on the stock is positive and unless the market comes off substantially this afternoon we should see it hold on to today's three percent gain above 23,800 pesetas," said a trader.
Fellow Spanish energy group Repsol, which owns a 45 percent stake in Gas Natural, is due to report its results shortly.
